method.focus: E1: Every obligation unit from the input delivery doc must have a corresponding fact, without weakening. Unitize doc via chapter anchors and ##/### headings (mixed); unstructured docs = whole doc + semantic hard-contract scan. Weakening (narrow list, blocking): quantity relaxations; must/forbidden → optional; negative constraints removed; interface fields dropped. Remediate only _facts.json. Do not edit the SoT doc.
